summary: Iteration 4 — Credit-system rewrite. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for the new shape ({plan, balance, used, next_credit_date, refill_amount}) and added coverage for the refill rule, /generate/optimize (LLM), /generate/save + list + delete, dashboard shape, and migration leftovers. All 13 backend tests pass. Frontend smoke run executed end-to-end against the preview URL: admin login → forced to free → sidebar (7 testids) verified → dashboard (6 cards + welcome + quick links + recent + fav-categories) verified → /generate produced a 1217-char optimized prompt via the AI service layer in ~5s and decremented credits 91 → 88 (cost-display reads 'Cost: 3 credits') → output-copy/save/export/favorite all visible → /saved (tab-generated + tab-favorites) → /billing (both plan cards + CTAs + billing-plan/remaining/next) with plan round-trip via /me/subscription → /settings (name/email/provider/plan/verified/password all populated) → /history loads → legacy redirects /favorites→/saved and /account→/settings both honoured. No critical defects detected.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is approaching ~1000 lines — start splitting routes into modules (auth, credits, promptlets, generator) before further iterations. Anything >700 lines becomes hard to navigate.
Atomic credit consumption via findOneAndUpdate with conditional balance would eliminate read-modify-write races.
/api/me/subscription has no Stripe gating — any signed-in user can flip themselves to pro. Acceptable as a placeholder per the spec, but flag clearly in code comments so this isn't shipped to prod.

Frontend Saved page fetches asynchronously; test counted 0 saved-copy-* immediately after navigation while the API already had 2 rows (probable render race). Consider adding a loading spinner with data-testid so tests can wait deterministically.
test_credentials: admin@promptai.app / Admin@PromptAI2025 (admin auto-seeds as pro; test now flips to free before exercising credit gating).
seed_data_creation: Multiple test_<hex>@example.com free users created during pytest run; one had credits_balance manually poked via motor to 0 with next_credit_date in the past to validate refill; another to 2 to validate 402. Admin's subscription was set to 'free' at start of the frontend run and left as 'free' at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest harness is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — runs in ~11s (parallel via pytest-xdist) and uses MONGO_URL + DB_NAME from backend/.env via set -a && source backend/.env && set +a for manual credit-balance pokes. Frontend testids confirmed: side-{dashboard,generate,marketplace,history,saved,billing,settings}, card-{balance,next-credit,credits-used,plan,monthly,total}, generator-optimize, output-{text,copy,save,export,favorite}, cost-display, credits-balance, tab-{generated,favorites}, plan-{free,pro}, plan-{free,pro}-cta, billing-{plan,remaining,next}, settings-{name,email,provider,plan,verified,password,resend-verify}. Legacy redirects /favorites→/saved and /account→/settings are wired. Optimize uses the PromptAI AI service boundary through NIMO-CORE.
